summary.text: Bob Hall is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 2 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A U.S. Air Force veteran and Citadel graduate, he previously worked as a consultant and commercial pilot.

paragraphs.text: Bob Hall graduated from The Citadel Military College in 1964 with a B.S. in electrical engineering, according to Ballotpedia.
He was commissioned a second lieutenant in the U.S. Air Force after graduation, with an assignment at Norton Air Force Base in California.
His professional experience includes work as president of Professional Proposal Management Incorporated, as a commercial pilot, as a consultant and as an Air Force captain.
Hall assumed office in the Texas State Senate in 2015.
In 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Finance, Health & Human Services, Local Government, and Veteran Affairs & Border Security committees, along with the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
